verdict.rationale: Mercury documents granular user permissions and organization approval policies that payment requests are routed through. These include dashboard sign-off before funds are released, optional approval controls on ACH, check, and wire payments, and marketing that describes permissioned teammates paying with "literally one click" and approving bills in seconds. missing for 10: in-depth docs on how a finance lead configures approver roles and approval rules, independent or hands-on corroboration of the approval workflow.
